description: Source code for AndroidPackagingCompiler class implementing PackagingCompiler interface, responsible for packaging Android applications within the build process, including processing build items, managing dependencies, and creating APKs.

classes.name: AndroidPackagingCompiler
classes.description: Main class implementing packaging compilation for Android projects, managing build items, processing, and APK creation.

classes.name: AptPackagingItem
classes.description: Represents a packaging item with all necessary data for building an Android APK, including paths, sources, libraries, and build options.

classes.name: MyValidityState
classes.description: Tracks the validity state of a packaging item to determine if rebuild is necessary based on resource timestamps and configuration.

methods.name: getExternalJars
methods.description: Retrieves external library files associated with a module based on its Android facet configuration.

methods.name: fillSourceRoots
methods.description: Recursively collects source roots from a module and its dependencies, excluding resource directories.

methods.name: getSourceRootsForModuleAndDependencies
methods.description: Returns all source roots for a module and its dependencies, including or excluding test sources.

methods.name: getProcessingItems
methods.description: Generates processing items for each relevant module, preparing data for packaging and APK building.

methods.name: createItem
methods.description: Creates a packaging item with all necessary paths and configurations for building an APK.

methods.name: collectNativeLibsFolders
methods.description: Collects native library folders from a module and its dependencies.

methods.name: getPaths
methods.description: Converts VirtualFile arrays to system-dependent path strings.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main processing method that builds APKs from packaging items during a full build.

methods.name: doProcess
methods.description: Executes the APK build process, including resource packaging, dex file handling, and copying final APKs.

methods.name: shouldGenerateApk
methods.description: Determines whether an APK should be generated based on build configuration and module settings.
